evidence.notes: scale_study.py loads the bronze tree lazily (only after the skip gate passes), uses rglob+concat per CLAUDE.md 7, samples deterministically via .sample(n=min(volume,len), random_state=42) with a cap-note when volume exceeds tree size. Timing boundary: kinematic_features + METHODS[method] run inside the perf_counter window; project_raw+clean+event_time_order are setup. RSS sampler is a daemon thread with a threading.Event stop and 500 ms tick; pre-start and post-join samples catch sub-tick cells. Insert row goes to the architecture.md scale_runs schema (13 cols, source='s3', noise='N0', engine='pandas', seed=42, shuffle_mb=NULL). Skip gate is a pure function _projection_exceeds(prior, target_volume, limit_mb=12000) exposed for testing; the DB-fetching _fetch_prior filters out NULL peak_rss_mb rows so propagated NULLs do not bypass the gate. DDL is idempotent and runs inside main() after the --dry-run early exit so imports stay side-effect-free. icao24 is reasserted as pandas string dtype on the silver frame. All stdout is ASCII (no arrows, no em-dashes).
